product_summary: Website dorsetindia.com (brand 'Dorset', 'Every Door Deserves a Dorset') lists: architectural hardware — door handles (lever), pull handles, door control systems (door closers, floor springs), door accessories (door hinges, tower bolt, door viewers, door guard & stoppers, safety bolt, double door attachment), glass solutions (patch fitting, glass combo set), panic bars (single/two/three point locking, external trim); locks & security — rim locks, mortise locks (heavy duty 3-stroke, 4-bolt, magnetic, roller latch, steel-door, sliding), euro profile cylinders, cylindrical knob locks, furniture locks (drawer, cupboard, wardrobe, cam lock), padlocks (square/round/disc); digital solutions — digital door locks, push-pull, fire-rated digital mortise, digital rim lock, glass-door digital lock, fingerprint/password drawer locks; furniture fitting & kitchen hardware — soft-close hinges, 3D adjustable hinges, ball-bearing/undermount slides, drawer systems, gas pistons, magic corner, carousel, pantry units, waste bins, cutlery trays; plus concealed hinges by Simonswerk (imported brand line). Manufacturing claimed at plants in Gurugram and Jammu; company describes itself as manufacturer of locks and architectural hardware. Source: https://www.dorsetindia.com/ , https://www.dorsetindia.com/products/architectural-hardware , https://www.dorsetindia.com/products/locks-security-systems

comment: HS mapping vs declared 830130/830160/830242/830260: (1) 830160 — CORRECT: euro profile cylinders, construction/computerized key cylinders are lock parts. (2) 830242 — CORRECT for the furniture-fitting/kitchen-hardware line (hinges, slides, drawer systems, pull-outs). (3) 830260 — CORRECT: door closers and floor springs are explicitly listed. (4) 830130 — WRONG/not corroborated: 830130 is 'locks of a kind used for furniture'. The site does list furniture/cupboard/drawer/wardrobe locks, so the code is defensible ONLY for that narrow line; however the dominant lock output is door locks (mortise, rim, cylindrical, padlocks), which fall in 830140, a code entirely absent from the declaration. Recommend adding 830140 as the primary lock code and keeping 830130 only for the furniture-lock line. (5) MISSING from declaration: 830140 (door locks/padlocks — the largest product family), 830210 (door and cabinet hinges), 830241 (tower bolts, door viewers, door guards, safety bolts, patch fittings, panic-bar trims — building fittings), possibly 830249 for glass hardware. (6) 830230 in my list is a caution flag only: no vehicle fittings appear on the site, so it should NOT be used. Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' is a rough fit — the company is an architectural hardware / door-ware and locks manufacturer (B2B building-hardware, retail via dealers), not a construction/DIY retailer; recommend re-labelling as 'architectural hardware & locks'. Trader signs: sells a third-party brand (Simonswerk concealed hinges) alongside own production, and runs a dealer network — so a manufacturer_trader classification is plausible for that line. All product data above is from the company's own website/catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or shipment record was available to me in this task, and I did not verify that dorsetindia.com is operated by the legal entity 'DORSET INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED' (registry check out of scope). Per rule 3, the HS discrepancy is not a rejection ground: company retained, codes corrected.
